matrix.execPackaging: useLegacyPackaging=true (extractNativeLibs=true): exec requires physical files in nativeLibraryDir; targetSdk>=29 SELinux forbids exec from app data dirs
matrix.note: Exec-form companion of node-runtime; consumers MUST pair node-cli:<node> with node-runtime:<node>. The AAR bundles only libnode_cli.so (libc++_shared.so is provided by node-runtime); LD_LIBRARY_PATH must include nativeLibraryDir when exec'ing.
